title: [v0.92.1][TAIL-06.22][architecture] Publish active boot paths and retire stale control-plane guidance
goal: Publish and enforce one source-backed active boot path per subsystem and retire stale ordinary C-SDLC v2 guidance.
summary: Distinguish active native C-SDLC v3 lifecycle authority from retained rollback code and ADL Runtime/product binaries, then repair stale current guidance.
required_outcome: Active docs, CLI help, selector, installed layout, and tests agree that native v3 is the sole ordinary lifecycle path while product/runtime and rollback-only surfaces are correctly classified.
target_files_surfaces: Current lifecycle/boot-path documentation, focused source-backed inventory, and issue-837 enforcement artifacts only.
repo_inputs: AGENTS.md; docs/csdlc-v3/CURRENT_AUTHORITY.md; csdlc-v3/operator/authority-selector.json; installed owner-binary manifests; active tooling and Runtime documentation.
acceptance_criteria: Exactly one ordinary lifecycle path; ADL and Runtime correctly classified; retained v2 has no ordinary route; docs/help/selector/layout/tests agree; focused validator and exact-head review pass.
non_goals: No deletion of retained rollback source, authority change, Runtime/lifecycle combination, or unrelated docs cleanup.
validation_plan: Derive the boot-path table from source and selectors, repair only stale current guidance, and run a focused validator with negative ambiguity fixtures.
dependencies: #505 / PR #591 cutover, current AGENTS.md, and docs/csdlc-v3/CURRENT_AUTHORITY.md.
demo_proof_requirements: Deterministic source-backed inventory and negative stale-guidance fixture; no live demo required.
deliverables: Per-subsystem boot-path table, source evidence, retained-generation classification, current-guidance repairs, focused guard, and review evidence.
notes_risks: Historical evidence and explicit rollback docs must remain allowed; broad scans must not confuse product binaries with lifecycle generations.
tooling_notes: Native C-SDLC v3 only; bound FastWork worktree; focused docs/contract validation.
issue_graph_notes: The sibling remediation denominator remains outside #837.
